messages:
marcus: quick async — starting a contract-gated rollout for OrionCorp for the new "per-org throttling" feature. need a quick ops sanity check before i flip the server flag.

 tina: which flag key are we using and what's the scope? per-org or per-account?

 marcus: per-org. flag key: `org_per_throttle_v2`. Scope: org_id only, entitlements checked against contract.version >= 2. non-org users unaffected. plan: canary 3 orgs (orion-42, orion-66, partner-alpha) ~5% traffic each, then 25% then 100.

 sean: do we have an allowlist for VIP seats? orion has two VIP customers that must be held back until legal signs off.

 marcus: good catch. VIPs: `orion-admin@orioncorp.com`, `ops@orioncorp.com` — they'll be explicitly excluded from the canary (allowlist deny). contract gating will still block them until CS confirms.

 alisha: ops checklist — ensure kill-switch is a single call. if monitoring spikes, we need 1-click disable. also add a fallback to old throttling behavior.

 marcus: kill-switch is `flags.set('org_per_throttle_v2', 'off')` via admin console + CLI. fallback route: if flag not active or disabled, request goes to `throttle_v1` path.

 sean: tagging @deploy-bot to run a dry-run in staging with the org allowlist. can someone post the staging org ids?

 alisha: staging orgs are `stg-orion-5` and `stg-orion-7`. i'll seed telemetry for 24h and validate perf.

 marcus: config snippet i'll use for canary (pasted):
```json
{
  "flag": "org_per_throttle_v2",
  "strategy": "org_allowlist",
  "allowlist": ["orion-42","orion-66","partner-alpha"],
  "exclude_list": ["orion-admin@orioncorp.com","ops@orioncorp.com"],
  "contract_min_version": 2,
  "rollout": ["5%","25%","100%"],
  "monitoring_windows": ["15m","1h","6h"]
}
```

 tina: lgtm. can we add a metric tag `rollout.orioncorp.v2` so cost/latency is tracked per-customer?

 marcus: yes will add. also wiring a trace tag to show fallback hits.

 deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #4872 queued for canary step 1 -> staging. status: queued.

 devops-bot: reminder: run smoke check after canary enable: `/run smoke org_per_throttle_v2 --org stg-orion-5` — report errors to #incidents if >1% error rate.

 alisha: i'll execute smoke and post results here within 30m. if green, we push to 25% canary tomorrow 09:00 PST.

 sean: frontend: heads up to show the new throttle UI for org admins, mark as "beta" during canary. pinging the FE squad for a quick PR review.

 marcus: @tina @alisha @sean thanks — biggest risks: contract mis-eval, VIP exposure, and unexpected latency. if anyone sees a regression, call the kill-switch and drop a note here.

 tina: acked. i'll watch traces and vendor GPU costs.

 alisha: smoke done: staging stg-orion-5 shows 0.2% 500s, p95 latency +12ms. telemetry logs uploaded to: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/2299012345

 marcus: great. proceeding with canary step 1 tonight 02:00 UTC. will update when step completes. :thumbsup:
